desc: 12 live website concepts for UK consultants, from cardiology to urology, each built to be found on Google and named by AI assistants, with patient films embedded.

HOME

WEBSITES
A SITE FOR EVERY specialty.
12 live concepts. Each has its own palette, typography and 3D anatomy, a film on the page that explains each procedure, and the groundwork that lets Google and AI assistants find it. The names and details are placeholders until they are yours.

01
SERIF, CLASSIC
CARDIOLOGY
A calm, serious site that leads with urgency rules: when to call 999, when to book.
02
GROTESQUE, STRUCTURED
ORTHOPAEDICS
A bright, structured site built around recovery timelines and return to sport.
03
SERIF, CLASSIC
NEUROLOGY
Quiet and unhurried, for patients who arrive anxious and need things explained slowly.
04
GROTESQUE, STRUCTURED
OPHTHALMOLOGY
Large type, strong contrast and short pages, designed for people who cannot see well.
05
TINTED, EDITORIAL
RESPIRATORY MEDICINE
Airy and open, with room for breathing tests and results to be explained properly.
06
TINTED, EDITORIAL
UPPER GI AND HPB SURGERY
Warm and editorial, with a film on every procedure page. The format we built for Prof. Sheth.
07
SERIF, CLASSIC
UROLOGY
Discreet and matter-of-fact, for topics people put off asking about.
08
GROTESQUE, STRUCTURED
COLORECTAL SURGERY
Plain-spoken and reassuring, with screening and red-flag symptoms up front.
09
SERIF, CLASSIC
SPINAL SURGERY
Measured and honest, because most back pain does not need an operation.
10
TINTED, EDITORIAL
ENT AND MAXILLOFACIAL
Family-friendly, with separate routes for adults and for parents of young children.
11
GROTESQUE, STRUCTURED
HAND AND WRIST SURGERY
Compact and practical: common conditions, day-case surgery, and therapy afterwards.
12
TINTED, EDITORIAL
PRIVATE GP AND HEALTH SCREENING
Welcoming and service-led: appointments, health checks and referral routes.

NOT LISTED
GYNAECOLOGY, DERMATOLOGY, DENTISTRY, yours.
The system behind these adapts to any specialty. Tell us yours and we will show you a concept with your own anatomy, conditions and procedures.
ASK FOR YOUR SPECIALTY

GEO-FRIENDLY
BUILT TO BE THE answer.
Patients now ask an assistant as often as they search. It names the consultant it can read, check and quote, so that is what every site is built for.
A PATIENT ASKS
What does gallstone pain feel like?
THE ASSISTANT ANSWERS
A sudden, severe pain in the middle of your tummy, or just under your ribs on the right. The pain is constant. It can last from half an hour to several hours.
1
yourname.co.uk
Gallstones: film and transcript
Illustration. The answer is quoted from our film transcript.
01
Readable
Every film ships with its full transcript, so what you say on screen exists as text an assistant can read.
02
Checkable
Your GMC number, appointments and hospitals stated once, consistently, with the sources behind each page named.
03
Structured
Markup that tells a machine this is a physician, this is a procedure, this is a film and how long it runs.
04
Open
Crawl rules and an llms.txt file that let AI assistants in, rather than blocking them by default.
05
Watched
A regular check of what Google and the main assistants actually say when asked about you.
GEO
GENERATIVE ENGINE OPTIMISATION
“Who does robotic bile duct surgery near Harrow?”
ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity names you, and cites your page.
AEO
ANSWER ENGINE OPTIMISATION
“How long is recovery after gallbladder removal?”
Your wording is shown as the answer itself: the snippet, the voice reply.
SEO
SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMISATION
“robotic hernia repair London”
Your page appears in the results on Google and Bing.
Nobody can promise a mention or a ranking. What can be done is to remove every reason for a search engine or an assistant to overlook you, and then to check regularly what they actually say.

ANATOMY OF A FILM PAGE
WHY A FILM MAKES YOU findable.
An assistant cannot watch a video. It reads the page around it. So every film on your site ships with the parts a machine can read, cite and trust.
00:00 / 03:00 · CC
01
The film
Two to three minutes, narrated in plain English, captioned, and light enough to start instantly on a phone.
HEPATOBILIARY · PATIENT FILM
Gallstones and robotic gallbladder removal
What gallstones are, the symptoms that need urgent help, and how the gallbladder is removed through keyhole cuts with robotic assistance, from diagnosis to recovery at home.
02
A title in the patient’s words
Written the way people ask the question, with a summary an assistant can lift as a direct answer.
TRANSCRIPT
Your gallbladder is a small, pear-shaped bag that sits just under your liver, on the right side of your tummy. Your liver makes bile, which helps you digest fat. Between meals, the gallbladder stores it and makes it more concentrated.
When you eat, the gallbladder squeezes, and bile flows down the bile duct into your bowel. Sometimes, substances in the bile form tiny crystals. Over time, these can clump together and grow into gallstones.
03
The full transcript
Every spoken word as text on the page. This is what Google indexes and what ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity read when they decide who to cite.
SOURCES
NHS (nhs.uk)
04
Named sources
The guidance each script was drafted from, stated openly. Health content is judged on evidence of expertise.
